scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 underlying clips; original outer design folds. No reserved selection/calibration/test scoring, new simulation, production default or GRU decision.
mechanisms: Mendez-inspired soft frequency-growth conditioning; not a reproduction of either paper
physical_prior: 8-component full-covariance Gaussian mixture over true critical growth [1/s], true critical frequency [Hz], and normalized margin. Training solver poles only; critical identity and all solver quantities unavailable at inference. Prior is empirical clip-weighted, not a deployment structural distribution.
observation: Largest measured growth among >=1%-energy modes and its frequency: frozen selected16/causal51/cap50/lag64 extraction, columns27/28 of cached107 features. No hidden true mode assignment at query time. Missing observations would use the population prior and be flagged, not invented modes; current cache has observations on all rows.
measurement_model: 2-component full-covariance Gaussian mixture of measured-minus-true critical pole errors on the four proper-fit acquisition views. Error distribution assumed independent of latent state; mode substitutions, growth clamping and state-dependent errors may violate this assumption. No outlier deletion or clipping.
controls: growth_only marginalizes the frequency observation; joint_naive treats the observed pole as exact; joint_soft integrates learned measurement error. All use the identical fitted joint physical prior. Oracle joint_naive with true critical poles is diagnostic only, including perfect mode identity. Matched32->16 MLP diagnostics on true versus measured growth/frequency, same design folds/capacity.
splits: For each outer fold, shuffle remaining designs seed947+fold and assign ceil20% to calibration, rest to proper fitting. Same split as existing warning models; calibration designs never fit priors, errors, scaling or MLPs. Keep every excitation/noise copy of a physical design together.
evaluation: Clean and historical sensitivity conditions plus eight frozen fresh independent/correlated1%/5% draws949-952. No outer-outcome hyperparameter selection; every arm retained regardless of result. Fresh noise does not constitute fresh structural validation.
references: Proper-fit one107, full174 and fixed50/50 blend, seeds42/43/44, from spatial_comprehensive warning_study. Reuse trusted own shards and verify hashes/splits; no reference refitting.
uncertainty: Raw posterior central90% intervals and instability probabilities. Also design-group-max CQR90% adjustment from four calibration views; finite-sample ceil((n_designs+1)*.9) order statistic, nonnegative correction. Reference raw intervals use calibration90% absolute residual radius. Held-out noise/mismatch results are descriptive, not operational certification or an arbitrary-shift coverage guarantee.
reference_probability: Frozen reference points are unchanged. For probability-score diagnostics only, use a zero-centered Gaussian residual approximation with RMS error learned on calibration designs; not a Bayesian posterior or validated Gaussian error claim. Its within-fold warning ranking is monotone in the original point estimate.
metrics: Design MAE; signed error and MAE on stable/unstable last1%/2%/5%; overestimation events; farther-stable underestimation; interval width/coverage/score; safe-declaration availability and unsafe false-safe rate; Brier/log score for posterior instability probabilities; warning/miss tradeoffs at calibrated1%/5%/10%/20% stable false-warning budgets. Soft growth estimates compared with true critical growth including bias/sign/MAE and near-boundary slices.
diagnostics: Identification error versus usable pre-cap time, critical cycles, abs(true growth)*usable time, energy, fit error and clamp fraction. True modes are TRAIN-only diagnostic targets. No fixed cycle cutoff adopted.
inference_timing: Warm cached measured pole to posterior distribution including quantiles, median/p95; raw extraction unchanged and not retimed. Report this timing boundary explicitly.
decision: No automatic adoption. Require useful boundary/decision behavior and calibrated uncertainty/availability, not only lower aggregate MAE or narrower intervals. Failed implementation does not refute joint physical inference generally. Preserve current predictors and GRU. Fixed-prediction2000 whole-design paired bootstrap, no refit or multiplicity guarantee.
